clips.send: Iron ore supplies iron oxides. Coke provides heat and helps make carbon monoxide. Limestone helps remove mineral impurities. Solids descend while hot gases rise. The animation isolates each process in turn. In an operating furnace, the processes run continuously. Blast-furnace pig iron contains more carbon than steel. Refining removes excess carbon and impurities to make steel.

clips.send: Magnesium, zinc, and iron react with dilute HCl to form magnesium chloride, zinc chloride, and iron(II) chloride, respectively. All three release hydrogen. Copper gives no hydrogen. The activity series helps predict whether a reaction can happen. The actual rate depends on factors such as temperature, surface area, and the condition of the metal surface. Zinc starts bubbling less vigorously than magnesium in this model. The bubbles are hydrogen.

clips.send: Most metals are shiny and conduct heat and electricity well. They can usually be pressed into sheets (malleability) or drawn into wires (ductility). Hardness, density, and melting point vary. Mercury is liquid at room temperature. An alloy (héjīn, 合金) is a metallic material made by combining a metal with other elements. Many alloys are harder than their main pure metal. Many also start melting at a lower temperature than that metal. Copper is common in wires because it conducts electricity well and is easy to draw into wire. Brass is a copper–zinc alloy. Its combination of workability and corrosion resistance makes it useful for fittings such as taps.

clips.send: Keep steel dry, or add a barrier such as paint or grease. Inspect and repair damaged coatings. Galvanizing adds a zinc barrier. At a small scratch, zinc can also oxidize before the iron does. Chromium in stainless steel helps form a protective surface film. A magnet can help separate ordinary steel from aluminum. Sorted steel scrap can be remelted, reducing demand for newly mined ore. Keeping products in use longer also saves resources.

clips.send: In a typical salt-solution test, a metal listed earlier can replace a metal listed later. This is a displacement reaction, also called single replacement. An element and a compound react to form a different element and a different compound. Use hydrogen’s position to predict whether a metal releases hydrogen gas from dilute HCl. clips.send: 保持钢铁表面干燥，或用油脂、油漆形成保护层。检查破损处，及时补涂。镀锌层能隔开铁与环境。小划痕处，锌还可以优先被氧化。含铬的不锈钢表面能形成保护膜。磁铁可帮助分离普通钢和铝。分类后的废钢可重新熔炼，减少对新开采矿石的需求。延长制品使用寿命也能节约金属资源。

clips.send: 一氧化碳夺取铁的氧化物中的氧，生成二氧化碳。这个总反应式表示氧化铁被还原成铁的过程。炉料向下，热气体向上。动画逐步展示各部分的作用；高炉正常运行时，这些过程是连续进行的。炼出的生铁含碳量比钢高，降低含碳量并去除杂质可以炼成钢。

clips.send: 在常见的盐溶液实验中，排在前面的金属通常能把排在后面的金属从其盐溶液中置换出来。这属于置换反应，即一种单质和一种化合物反应，生成另一种单质和另一种化合物。氢是判断金属能否从稀盐酸中置换出氢气的参照。适用范围：钾、钙、钠会与水反应，不能直接套用水溶液中的金属置换规律。铝表面的氧化膜可能使实验现象不明显。

clips.send: 镁、锌、铁与稀盐酸反应，分别生成氯化镁、氯化锌和氯化亚铁，同时都生成氢气。铜在稀盐酸中不产生氢气。活动性顺序可用于预测反应能否发生。实际反应速率还受温度、表面积和表面状态等因素影响。在这个模型中，铁起初冒泡比锌慢。铁与稀盐酸反应生成氯化亚铁和氢气。

clips.send: 多数金属有金属光泽，具有良好的导电性、导热性和延展性，可以压成薄片或拉成细丝。不同金属的硬度、密度和熔点不同。汞在室温下是液体。合金，alloy，是由一种金属和其他元素组成、具有金属特性的材料。许多合金比其主要成分的纯金属更硬，也有不少合金在更低的温度就开始熔化。电线芯常用铜，因为铜导电性好，也容易拉成细丝。黄铜是铜锌合金，易于加工，又比较耐腐蚀，常用来制造水龙头等零件。

clips.send: 石灰石中的碳酸钙受热分解生成氧化钙。第二个方程式表示氧化钙与二氧化硅反应生成炉渣中的一种成分。熔融炉渣的密度比铁水小，浮在铁水上方。图中用不同的出口表示这两层的流向。炉料向下，热气体向上。动画逐步展示各部分的作用；高炉正常运行时，这些过程是连续进行的。炼出的生铁含碳量比钢高，降低含碳量并去除杂质可以炼成钢。
